tools.name: Eidetic Engine
tools.description: Durable, local-first, explainable memory CLI for coding agents.

windows.standalone: $Installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'install-ee.ps1'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing 'https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/eidetic_engine_cli/releases/download/v0.16.0/install.ps1' -OutFile $Installer; if (Test-Path $Installer) { & $Installer -Version '0.16.0' -Verify } else { Write-Error 'Installer download failed' }

linux.standalone: set -euo pipefail; Installer="$(mktemp)"; trap 'rm -f "$Installer"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/eidetic_engine_cli/releases/download/v0.16.0/install.sh" -o "$Installer"; test -s "$Installer"; EE_VERSION=v0.16.0 bash "$Installer" --easy-mode --verify

wsl2.standalone: set -euo pipefail; Installer="$(mktemp)"; trap 'rm -f "$Installer"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/eidetic_engine_cli/releases/download/v0.16.0/install.sh" -o "$Installer"; test -s "$Installer"; EE_VERSION=v0.16.0 bash "$Installer" --easy-mode --verify

notes: Binary and command identifier are ee; the upstream repository and Cargo package use different names.
Local-first memory store; initialize each workspace explicitly with ee init --workspace . before workspace workflows.
Installation does not modify agent settings or automatically import CASS history; use ee import cass explicitly when desired.
Release installer verifies SHA-256 checksums; add --require-provenance to require provenance verification when available.
provenance: Eidetic Engine README and installation guide verified 2026-09-30; release v0.16.0.
